units.source_text: “与其如此，倒不如全同孩子一般驯良的女子，可由丈夫尽力教导，养成美好品质。

en.t: Rather than that, it would be better to have a woman as gentle and obedient as a child, whom her husband can teach with all his effort and raise into fine qualities.

units.source_text: 这种女子虽然未必尽可信赖，但教养总有效果。

en.t: Such a woman may not be entirely dependable, but education and training will always have some effect.

units.source_text: 和她对面相处之时，眼见其可爱之相，但觉所有缺陷，都属可恕；

en.t: When one lives face to face with her and sees her charming manner, all her faults seem forgivable.

units.source_text: 然而一旦丈夫远离，吩咐她应做之事，以及别离期间偶尔发生之事，

en.t: Yet once her husband is far away, with tasks he has instructed her to do and matters that happen now and then during their separation,

units.source_text: 不论玩乐还是正事，这女子处理之时总不能自出心裁，不能周到妥帖，实甚遗憾。

en.t: whether they concern amusement or serious business, she cannot handle them with any invention of her own or with proper care, which is truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 这种不可信赖的缺点，也是教人为难的。

en.t: This flaw of being unreliable is also something that makes matters difficult for people.

units.source_text: 更有一种女子，平时冥顽不灵，毫无可爱之相，而偶值时机，却会显示高明手段，真乃意想不到。”

en.t: There is also another kind of woman who is usually stubborn, dull, and not at all charming, yet when the occasion arises she displays remarkable skill, which is truly unexpected.
